The system shall provide a digest or summary view for alerts.
The interface shall show the original source value for each flagged item.
The interface shall show the reason an item was rejected or left ambiguous so analysts can resolve it quickly without digging through logs.
The system shall highlight items with the biggest compliance or project risk first.
The system shall prioritize items that affect many goals, requirements, or trace links.
The system shall provide filters for urgency, policy area, project, and affected source.
The system shall support sorting by impact.
The analyst workflow shall allow an analyst to open a flagged item.
The analyst workflow shall allow an analyst to compare competing values.
The analyst workflow shall allow an analyst to choose the correct mapping or mark the item for escalation.
The system shall record the analyst's decision so the same issue does not keep coming back.
SPRAT shall log who made the decision after a resolution.
SPRAT shall log the evidence or reasoning used to make the decision after a resolution.
SPRAT shall update the related trace links after a resolution.
SPRAT shall show that the item is resolved after a resolution.
SPRAT shall keep the previous state available for audit after a resolution.
SPRAT shall provide a notification or activity feed entry to inform the team that the conflict was handled.
SPRAT shall provide a notification or activity feed entry so the team can see whether anything downstream was affected.
